name: Salete (Brazil)
description: Divided per bend white over dark blue with a dark blue border, charged at the centre with the municipal shield in white.
history: Salete is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 155 of 25 November 1970, and that it is also used without the blue border.

features.role: white upper hoist and dark blue lower fly
municipal shield with a pine, a cogwheel and waves
